notes: Changed: PhET's simulations are now CC BY-NC 4.0, not CC BY 4.0 as this entry said. Checked against PhET's licensing page and Terms of Use (effective 20 September 2026); both pages build their text with a script, so the quotes are found in the script the pages load. PhET lists "Incorporating simulations into paid or subscription-based products" as commercial use, which needs a commercial licence from the University of Colorado Boulder, so an app may not show or embed a simulation. The Terms of Use go further and forbid linking to PhET or directing traffic to it "for commercial activities" without a commercial agreement, so this entry says none: an app doesn't even link to it until the owner decides whether a link from a free part of Ceder is allowed, or Ceder gets a licence. The PhET name and logo are trademarks. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
